nodes.question: What are the two main types of silicon steels, and how do they differ?
nodes.answer: The two main types are non-oriented (NGO) and grain-oriented (GO) silicon steels. NGO steels have isotropic magnetic properties suitable for generator cores and electric motors, while GO steels are engineered for preferred magnetic orientation, excelling in high-efficiency transformers and motors.
